meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative data. This demonstration is not connected to Karnataka Government systems.
meta.boundaryNote: District boundaries follow the Census 2011 outline. Vijayanagara is not drawn separately on this illustrative map.
meta.separationNote: These are Labour Commissionerate records. They are not KBOCW Board worker registrations, and the two registers are not assumed to be synchronised.
meta.stageNote: Cess assessed and cess collected are separate stages. Outstanding assessed cess is assessed minus collected. Amounts already collected stay out of this balance, including cess that has been collected and is awaiting remittance.
